summary: iter350 — Pinterest Catalog Sync TSV feed: 19/19 backend HTTP tests PASSED against live preview URL. Verified /api/pinterest/catalog/health schema+types+counts, /api/pinterest/catalog.tsv content-type+disposition, exact 15-column header order, all row-level validations (id/title/https links/price NNN.NN USD/availability enum/condition=new/brand non-empty), seed-image absolute-URL conversion to https://craftersmarket.org/seed-images/*, User-Agent heuristic (Pinterestbot bumps last_pinterest_fetch_at; curl leaves it untouched while updating last_any_fetch_ua), 83 published products served, streaming/sizeable body, and /api/products?limit=5 regression.
critical_code_review_comments: pinterest_catalog.py `_availability` returns 'in stock' as fallback when status is null and in_stock is unparseable — could mask data-quality issues; consider 'out of stock' as the safer default to avoid Pinterest serving out-of-stock items as in-stock.

The maker_cache in `_tsv_stream` is request-scoped (rebuilt every fetch). With ~83 products and a daily Pinterest crawl this is fine, but for larger catalogs (5k+) consider promoting it to a TTL-cached module-level dict to amortize maker lookups across crawls.

GOOGLE_CATEGORY_MAP is hard-coded to 5 categories — any new category in the catalog (e.g. Jewelry & Wearables from iter330) silently emits empty google_product_category. Consider extending the map or logging a WARN once per missing-category so coverage gaps surface in admin logs.

_BAD_CHARS strips tabs/newlines but not embedded HTML entities or backslashes — Pinterest's parser is lenient but if descriptions contain raw HTML they'll render as text in pins. Optional: strip HTML tags from product descriptions before emit.
test_credentials: None — endpoints are public (no auth required), per spec same posture as /api/seo/diag and /api/sitemap.xml.
seed_data_creation: Two log rows were inserted into db.pinterest_feed_logs during testing — one with UA 'Pinterestbot/1.0' and one with UA 'curl/8.0' — to exercise the UA heuristic. No product data created/modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live HTTP test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter350_pinterest_catalog_http.py is re-runnable as a regression. It deliberately uses `requests` against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL instead of FastAPI TestClient to sidestep the motor/event-loop pollution flagged in the iter350 scaffold. Feed currently serves 83 products, all valid. UA heuristic test is timing-sensitive (uses 1s sleeps and relies on log-row ordering); if other concurrent crawlers hit the feed during the test window it could be flaky — currently stable on solo runs.
